findings.message: qcc/q++ invocation detected without stack protector (-fstack-protector-strong) hardening.
qcc invocation lacks explicit target architecture variant flag.

findings.matched_text: #define SENSOR_PULSE_CODE -1  // QNX002: Negative pulse code collides with kernel-reserved pulses
findings.message: Negative pulse code '-1' conflicts with QNX kernel-reserved pulse codes.
findings.remediation: Use positive pulse codes in the range _PULSE_CODE_MINAVAIL (0) to _PULSE_CODE_MAXAVAIL (127).

findings.message: ChannelCreate() called with flags=0. Channel lacks priority inheritance or fixed-priority scheduling.
findings.remediation: Configure _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY or priority inheritance flags on real-time service channels.

findings.message: LD_LIBRARY_PATH contains relative path or writable directory (/tmp, /var).
findings.remediation: Restrict library search path exclusively to /proc/boot:/lib:/usr/lib.

findings.message: Hardcoded sensitive credential identified in QNX buildfile.
findings.remediation: Inject credentials at runtime via encrypted filesystem or secure configuration daemon.

findings.message: Insecure file permission mask '0777' allows world-write access in QNX image.
findings.remediation: Change permission attribute to [perms=0755] for executables or [perms=0644] for read-only data.
